en-US: Fix GitHub marketplace plugin installs failing with Failed to fetch on desktop. The instance now resolves official releases and downloads plugin assets, so daily updates no longer need a client-side GitHub API round trip. Update both the instance and the desktop app.

Fix Docker/NAS upgrades that drop container environment variables, leaving login working while AI and object-storage credentials could no longer be encrypted and new model services could not be added. The encryption root is stored on the data volume and generated when missing; the add-service form no longer looks fillable while encryption is unavailable. If saved credentials cannot be decrypted, re-enter the API key.
Fix the AI settings pane crashing when provider names, base URLs, or tag-suggestion prompts are missing.
zh-CN: 修复桌面端从 GitHub 插件市场安装失败（Failed to fetch）的问题。实例会代为解析官方 Release 并下载插件，日常更新不再依赖客户端直接访问 GitHub。请同时更新实例和桌面端。
修复 Docker/NAS 升级丢掉容器环境变量后，登录仍可用但无法加密保存 AI 与对象存储凭据、也无法添加模型服务的问题。加密根密钥会写入数据卷，缺失时自动生成；加密仍不可用时“添加服务”不再呈现为可填写。若已保存的密钥无法解密，请重新填写 API Key。
修复 AI 设置在服务名称、接口地址或标签建议提示词缺失时崩溃的问题。
